posts: Just realized I've been overcomplicating everything. Sometimes the best solution is the simplest one.
Three years of coding taught me this: the bug is always in the last place you look. Because you stop looking after you find it.
Ship fast, iterate faster. Perfection is the enemy of progress.
Reading old code I wrote 6 months ago. Either I was a genius then or I'm an idiot now. Probably both.
The best time to start was yesterday. The second best time is right now.
